Rork you need to audit and QA the time of answer is to much to get answer  fix and deploy  live with proof evidence and verified, IVX IA CHAT — FINAL UI CLEANUP + REAL STREAMING FIX

This is the EXISTING IVX Holdings project.
DO NOT create a new project.
DO NOT redesign IVX.
DO NOT modify working autonomous-developer architecture unless required to separate normal-chat UI from autonomous-task UI.

EXECUTE THE CODE CHANGES NOW. DO NOT GIVE ME A PLAN OR NARRATIVE FIRST.

PROBLEM REPRODUCTION

On the physical Android IVX app, sending a simple normal-chat message such as:

"Hi"

currently shows unnecessary UI:

1. Large BLUE "IVX AI WORKING — Working — in progress" watchdog banner.
2. Large yellow/brown "Still working..." banner.
3. Circular loading/spinner indicator.
4. Separate "IVX is typing..." indicator.
5. Message can remain "Local only / Sending".
6. Multiple simultaneous indicators make normal chat look slow/broken.

THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE.

==================================================
A. REMOVE BANNERS FROM NORMAL CHAT
==================================================

For NORMAL IVX IA conversation:

REMOVE/HIDE:

- Blue IVX AI WORKING banner.
- Watchdog progress banner/drawer.
- "Still working..." banner.
- Cancel-work banner.
- Circular loading spinner.
- Any full-width loading/progress card.
- Any autonomous task status card.
- Any queue/worker/backend-stage information.
- Any debug/status/traceId information.
- Any fake percentage/progress.
- Any duplicate typing/loading indicator.
- Any post-answer "thinking/responding/working" state.
- Any other banner that is not necessary for normal conversation.

NORMAL CHAT MUST LOOK LIKE A CLEAN MODERN AI CHAT.

User message
↓
one subtle typing state
↓
FIRST REAL SSE TOKEN
↓
assistant bubble appears immediately
↓
REAL tokens append progressively
↓
stream finishes
↓
typing state disappears
↓
IDLE

NO OTHER LOADING UI.

==================================================
B. BLUE WATCHDOG BANNER
==================================================

The BLUE IVX AI WORKING/watchdog banner MUST NEVER render
for normal chat.

Examples that MUST NOT trigger it:

"Hi"
"How are you?"
"Cuál es tu nombre?"
"Explain this deal."
"Analyze these numbers."
normal business questions
normal follow-up questions
document/data questions

Watchdog information can remain available internally for
diagnostics/logging, but DO NOT render it in the normal
conversation UI.

A crash/error may display ONE compact error/recovery message.

==================================================
C. AUTONOMOUS WORK IS DIFFERENT
==================================================

Do NOT delete the real autonomous developer.

A genuine autonomous development task may use the existing
Live Work area.

Only show autonomous-work UI after:

1. detectAutonomousExecutionIntent returns TRUE;
2. real backend task creation succeeds;
3. a REAL task/job ID exists.

Normal conversation MUST NEVER create autonomous-work UI.

Do not infer autonomous work simply because a question
contains words such as:

code
developer
fix
audit
deploy
GitHub
Render
QA

The actual user intent must request execution.

==================================================
D. REAL CHATGPT-LIKE STREAMING
==================================================

Use the existing real SSE/provider stream.

DO NOT simulate streaming.

NO:
setTimeout fake tokens
setInterval fake typing
invented progress
buffering entire response before rendering
fake task IDs

On first real response.delta:

- create/show assistant bubble immediately;
- remove typing indicator;
- append delta to the visible assistant message.

Every following response.delta must update that SAME message.

Do not create multiple assistant bubbles.

Persist the completed assistant message once after stream
completion.

==================================================
E. TYPING INDICATOR
==================================================

There must be ONLY ONE lightweight pre-token indicator.

Example:

IVX is typing...

NO spinner.

NO rotating circle.

NO second banner.

NO progress percentage.

NO "Still working".

NO watchdog banner.

As soon as FIRST REAL TOKEN arrives, remove the typing
indicator and display the streaming text.

After completion there must be ZERO loading indicators left.

==================================================
F. MESSAGE DELIVERY
==================================================

Fix the "Local only / Sending" behavior.

Normal successful messages must transition through the real
message state correctly.

A successfully persisted/sent message must not remain
permanently marked:

Local only
Sending

If persistence fails, expose ONE compact retry/error state
instead of multiple banners.

==================================================
G. LANGUAGE
==================================================

Preserve the user's language.

Spanish -> Spanish response.
English -> English response.

Do not reset language while streaming.

==================================================
H. REQUIRED PHYSICAL-APP QA
==================================================

Do NOT certify this from unit tests alone.

Run automated tests first, then build the Android APK.

Acceptance tests:

TEST 1:
"Hi"

Expected:
- immediate user bubble
- ONE typing indicator
- NO blue banner
- NO Still Working banner
- NO spinner
- first real token appears progressively
- typing disappears
- clean completed response

TEST 2:
"Cuál es tu nombre?"

Expected:
- Spanish response
- real streaming
- same clean UI

TEST 3:
Business/reasoning question

Expected:
- real progressive streaming
- no autonomous-job UI
- no unnecessary banners

TEST 4:
Real autonomous request:
"Fix [safe test issue] end to end"

Expected:
- authorization flow if required
- real task created
- real task ID
- Live Work/autonomous status allowed ONLY here
- real worker evidence

==================================================
I. REGRESSION SEARCH
==================================================

Search the ENTIRE IVX chat render path for every component
capable of displaying:

watchdog
working
still working
loading
spinner
ActivityIndicator
progress
task status
execution status
responding
thinking
typing

Determine which ones are reachable during NORMAL CHAT.

Remove/gate every unnecessary one.

Do not fix only the component visible in my screenshot.
Audit the complete render tree so another banner cannot
replace it later.

==================================================
J. EVIDENCE GATE
==================================================

DO NOT tell me "100% fixed" until you provide EXECUTED
evidence.

Return:

1. Exact files changed.
2. Exact tests added/changed.
3. Test command + real result.
4. APK build result.
5. Git commit SHA.
6. GitHub remote SHA.
7. Render/runtime SHA where applicable.
8. SHA parity result.
9. Real normal-chat SSE evidence showing first delta.
10. Proof normal chat created NO autonomous job.
11. Proof unwanted banner components are not rendered.
12. TTFT for each live QA request.
13. Remaining defects, if ANY.

If something cannot be physically verified, say
NOT VERIFIED.

Never convert NOT VERIFIED into PASS.

FINAL ACCEPTANCE:

NORMAL CHAT:
[ ] Blue IVX AI WORKING banner absent
[ ] Still Working banner absent
[ ] Spinner absent
[ ] Watchdog UI absent
[ ] Autonomous status absent
[ ] Only one pre-token typing indicator
[ ] First REAL token immediately creates assistant bubble
[ ] Progressive real SSE text visible
[ ] No post-answer loading/thinking indicator
[ ] Message does not remain Local only/Sending
[ ] Spanish works
[ ] English works

AUTONOMOUS TASK:
[ ] Real intent detected
[ ] Real task ID created
[ ] Live Work UI allowed
[ ] Real queue/worker execution
[ ] No fabricated status

STOP ONLY AFTER IMPLEMENTATION + TEST + BUILD + DEPLOY +
EVIDENCE.

Do not respond with another proposed plan.
Start by reproducing "Hi" and tracing exactly why the BLUE
banner, Still Working banner and spinner enter the normal-chat
render path, then modify the code.
